correctness.rationale: Direct substitution reduces every column of the source sheared Fourier system to y''=(q+1)y. For nonzero streamwise frequency the quadratic q gives Weber's equation with a nonvanishing parabolic-cylinder Wronskian; reconstruction gives the full matrix, Liouville gives the determinant, and standard parabolic-cylinder asymptotics plus the determinant give both singular-value laws. Symbolic and numerical checks reproduce the identities.

originality.rationale: The source derives the equivalent scalar second-order equation but stops at Volterra/Gronwall estimates and does not state the Weber identification, closed 2x2 Green matrix, determinant-based singular-value pair, or quadratic condition-number splitting. Searches found no source-specific correction or SCOPE overlap. Two related micropolar-Couette papers remain a residual risk because their complete proof bodies were not fully inspected.

value.rationale: The result supplies an exact benchmark for a coupled variable-coefficient Green system that the source treats only by estimates, and it separates common cubic enhanced dissipation from a quantitatively explicit quadratic nonnormal splitting. This can guide sharper frequency-localized estimates and general-viscosity comparisons.
